# S5.8 — surface ecosystem + compatibility machinery (§7.4/§5a.5/§5a.3; R-2.11.4, R-2.2.5², R-2.2.3²)

**Stacked on:** `svitali/harnessharness-s5.7` (PR #89) · **Do not merge — operator-controlled**

## Summary

Lands the compatibility machinery the surface ecosystem needs at
contract major 1, plus the `R-2.2.5²`/`R-2.2.3²` extension legs.

**Compatibility (R-2.11.4 C1).** Ops carry a declared
`OpDeprecation`; dispatch mints durable
`lifecycle.contract.deprecated_use{method, client}` and the ledger
folds `(method, client)` counts as a rebuildable projection. The
compatibility matrix is a generated artifact —
`schema/compat-1.matrix.json` comes out of `hh-codegen` and
`check-drift.sh` diffs it like the schema export and the client
(CC7). AC-R-2.11.4-11's "no private verb" claim is executable:
`surface_inventory.rs` scans every method-position literal in each
surface crate against the op registry, and the committed report
(`docs/build/reports/S5.8-surface-inventory.md`) lists per-surface
ops + tiers and records the OQ-130 confirmation — trigger 6 unfired,
Q-L1-14 un-narrowed.

**Environments (R-2.2.5²).** `env.snapshot{kind}` accepts `memory`
through the provider adapter (tri-state honesty — undeclared answers
`unknown`); `suspend{on_idle:"hibernate"}` takes the memory snapshot
inside the suspend batch; `restore_in_place` is a declared driver
capability and heal/replace prefers a memory snapshot; attested
microVM images carry an attestation pairing on `EnvironmentRecord`,
validated at resolve with containment backends fail-closed.

**Durability surfaces (R-2.2.3²).** `control.wakeup.*` lowers to MCP
tasks/push durable-first: `deliver_due_wakeups` mints
`occurred`/`fired` before any delivery, dedups on
`(subscription, occurrence)`, and the tasks carrier pushes narrowed
`notifications/tasks{taskId}` — clients re-read `tasks/get`. A
provably-dead writer re-attaches via
`resume{mode:"takeover", cause:"wakeup"}`. The hosted
`session/resume` mapping declares `cause` from the durable tail
(attach-scan: wakeup-fired suspension ⇒ `wakeup`, else `operator`),
and suspended runs stay exempt from liveness takeover.
